chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
When a woman rises from her seat, no one should sit in that place until it has cooled down.
ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about sitting in a woman’s seat after she gets up?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a form of social etiquette concerning a woman’s place after she leaves her seat. It indicates respect for personal space and modest social conduct in gatherings.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4903 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"When a woman leaves her seat, no one should sit in that place until it has cooled down."
